theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.77%) and Health Care (-0.11%) led the market today, while Consumer Discretionary (-1.53%) and Utilities (-1.08%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.95%, defensives -0.63%, and value/cyclicals -0.11% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.49%, Dow -0.93%, Nasdaq -0.69% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.87%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 2.75% to 17.57, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.31% to $4,331.80, crude oil was little changed at $104.82, and bitcoin slipped 2.29% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
